title: Create an ISO image from a folder
summary: Create a hybrid ISO image file from the contents of a specific directory.

steps.explain: Creates a new ISO image file containing the contents of the specified directory.

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: Path for the new ISO file (e.g., ~/Desktop/backup.iso)

placeholders.name: SOURCE_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the folder you want to include in the image
